title: B.Sc. in Information Engineering
description: The program combines computer science, computer engineering, and management to teach the design of interconnected IT systems. The curriculum covers software engineering, databases, networks, and embedded systems.

title: Computer Science
description: The curriculum teaches programming by building increasingly complex software projects, collaborating with peers, and evaluating each other’s work.

title: B.Sc. in Computer Science
description: The program combines computing theory and systems with hands-on projects. Core subjects include programming, data structures and algorithms, databases, and operating systems.
